review.assemblyDescription: {{ready}}/{{total}} positions have video. After a successful regeneration, the new attempt automatically replaces the previous one in this slot; the old one stays in History.
review.noDialogueDuration: No dialogue: visual duration is editable.
review.minimumLimited: The model’s native minimum leaves unspoken visual room.
review.requiresSplit: The dialogue exceeds one clip’s maximum; split it before rendering.
review.usePendingTakesHint: Use pending takes fills empty finals only. Existing chosen takes stay unless you explicitly replace finals. Incomplete, rejected, or missing media are omitted ({{kept}} kept · {{omitted}} omitted).
review.savedMetadata: Saved generation request and result metadata
review.durableQueueHint: Completed shots survive cancellation and restart. Approved shots are never included in bulk missing/failed runs.
review.historyHint: Each shot keeps its immutable generation history. The latest completed alternative occupies the same ordered slot; approving it changes the final export.
review.noPlayable: This slot does not have a playable video yet.
review.saveRegenerate: Save and regenerate in this slot
review.editorHandoffHint: {{ready}}/{{total}} shots have an approved output. The editor opens with the saved Series resolution and orientation.
review.openEditor: Open complete approved sequence in Video Editor
review.approveAllFirst: Approve every shot before opening the final sequence. This prevents an accidental partial export.
review.canonDeltaHint: Only accepted items affect future episode snapshots. Rejected/pending items never mutate canon.
review.playAllStopped: Play all stopped because the active shot is no longer playable.
review.shotPlayErrorContinue: Shot {{order}} could not be played; continuing with the next available shot.

library.empty: Create an empty original series or import an existing Story Lab bible.
library.spokenHint: Forces every dialogue prompt; regional accent remains model-dependent.
library.title: Series Lab
library.emptyBody: Series → Season → Episode → Scene → Shot → append-only Attempts, with reviewed canon and deterministic H3 references.

blockers.message: Episode production is blocked until the persistent bible is reviewed.
blockers.reviewApproveFirst: Review and approve the canon before creating an episode.

storyImport.title: Import Story as a new draft series
storyImport.description: The source Story and its historical productions are not modified.

setup.incomplete: Complete the violet fields before planning canon or episodes
setup.knownTitle: Fill from a known series · one click
setup.knownDescription: Describe the existing series or universe. The writing model fills setup, recurring cast, relationships, locations, props, rules and chronology as an editable draft.
setup.knownPlaceholder: I want new Seinfeld episodes, keeping their characters, relationships, places and tone…
setup.knownDisclaimer: Uses the selected writing model's general knowledge, not live web research. It does not copy scripts or dialogue, and facts may be incomplete: review the draft before approving canon. Publishing or monetizing third-party characters still requires the appropriate rights.
setup.applyErrorHint: Start the action again after reviewing your edits.
setup.draftFilled: Draft filled: {{characters}} recurring characters · {{locations}} locations · {{relationships}} relationships · {{props}} props.
setup.draftReview: Review Series identity, Source mode and the Canon tabs. Nothing has been approved automatically.
setup.replaceConfirm: This will replace the current setup and bible with a generated draft. Existing episodes and uploaded assets are preserved. Continue?
setup.prepareDescription: Both actions create a durable proposal first. Nothing replaces hand-edited canon until you inspect and apply the diff.
setup.needImageModel: Choose an explicit local image model below before using the image action; Series Lab will not silently select or download a recommended model.
setup.proposalSummary: Proposal: {{characters}} principal characters · {{locations}} locations · {{rules}} immutable rules
setup.applyCanonImages: Apply reviewed canon and generate missing images
setup.imageUnavailable: Generated image for {{name}} is no longer available

identity.title: Series identity
identity.description: These fields are reused in every episode snapshot.
identity.durationHint: Long episodes add more shots. Dialogue shots are timed from syllables and rounded upward to the model's native duration.

visual.title: Visual continuity
visual.description: Style is separate from narrative prompts and is frozen into each episode snapshot.
visual.textPolicyHint: Dialogue remains audio; disabling this also adds a no-captions constraint to H3 prompts.
visual.allowText: Allow intentional readable text in clips
visual.nativeDialogueHint: MiniMax H3 native audio uses exact dialogue and emotion, but mouth synchronization remains best-effort.
visual.lipSync: I understand lip sync is best-effort
visual.protagonistHint: Optional. Requires an approved primary portrait and routes it as the identity authority.
visual.identityMissing: Generate or upload this character portrait in Canon, mark it primary, then approve it before rendering.

source.title: Source mode and rights note
source.description: Known-universe behavior is experimental; its generated master prompt remains fully editable.
source.rightsHint: Publication or monetization of third-party characters requires appropriate rights.
source.experimentalWarning: Experimental direct mode relies on probabilistic model familiarity and can drift across model versions. Review the generated master prompt and canon, then add approved visual references when identity matters.

providers.title: Providers and render canvas
providers.description: Series keeps its own saved defaults; a job records the exact effective values.
providers.videoModelHint: Series stores the family/variant. Shot strategy chooses frames vs references; Fused stays Fused.
providers.unknownModel: This saved ID is not in the H3 catalog. Send will keep it; it will not silently become pruned H3.
providers.fusedStepsHint: Fused accepts 4–8 total steps. Four is the published speed recipe.

canon.worldDescription: Approved revision {{revision}}. Episode snapshots keep their original revision.
canon.noFacts: No episode continuity has been committed yet.
canon.charactersDescription: A visible recurring character receives a routed identity reference; speakers have priority.
canon.voicesDescription: TTS comes from the linked library character. Pace, pitch and pronunciation here are series notes; they do not control MiniMax H3. Spoken audio follows the shot dialogue.
canon.kitTtsHint: TTS preset comes from the linked library character.
canon.unlinkedTtsHint: Link a library character to use its TTS. Provider and voice ID below are fallbacks only.
canon.voiceIdHint: Fallback only when no library character is linked. H3 does not consume this ID.

episode.heading: Episode {{number}} · {{title}}
episode.frozen: Frozen canon revision {{revision}}. Planning cannot mutate the current series canon.
episode.title: Episode title
episode.roomDescription: Generated material is a recoverable proposal. Apply is explicit and conflicts if you edited the episode while it was running.
episode.instructionPlaceholder: Optional episode constraints, required beat, character focus…
episode.adaptToComicConfirm: Replace the current Comic draft with this episode adaptation?
episode.scriptDescription: Reorder scenes and edit exact action/dialogue without regenerating the rest.
episode.staleDialogueTitle: Shots out of date with the script
episode.staleDialogueDescription: {{stale}} shot(s) still have the previous dialogue. {{conflicts}} have a manual shot edit that will not be overwritten.
episode.staleDialogueHint: Sync copies script lines onto those shots. Historical takes stay. Rendering is blocked until this is resolved.
episode.syncBeforeRender: {{count}} shot(s) still use the previous script dialogue. Sync them in Episode before rendering.
episode.validationDescription: Validation flags issues but never silently rewrites the script.
episode.noIssues: No structured continuity issue was reported.

proposal.title: Generated proposal — review and edit
proposal.description: Every visible field below can be corrected before applying. Internal IDs remain protected.
proposal.outlineDescription: Edit, remove or add story beats.
proposal.scriptDescription: {{count}} scene cards · action, states and dialogue are editable.
proposal.timedDescription: {{count}} readable shot cards in start-to-finish order.
proposal.speakerMustStay: A speaking character must remain visible
proposal.continuityDescription: Warnings and proposed canon changes are shown as separate cards.

shots.title: Shot breakdown
shots.description: {{count}} shots · {{duration}}s planned · exact ID routing before render
shots.lipSyncBody: MiniMax H3 generates native speech, but exact mouth synchronization is best-effort. Accept it once for this series.
shots.empty: Generate and apply an episode proposal to create enough shots for the target runtime. Dialogue duration is calculated from syllables.
shots.speaker: Speaker · {{name}}
shots.routePreview: Route references to preview the exact H3 input.

references.fromDescription: Update from the subject and series style
references.hint: The image is linked to this subject. Review and approve the canon to use it in production.
references.refreshHint: Update this episode’s images while keeping its story and earlier takes.
references.approveFirst: Approve the canon with the new images before adding them to this episode.
references.locationHint: Before generation, the description is adapted to this empty location. The visual style is preserved while occupants and character-design instructions are removed. Prepare the prompt here to review it first.

production.title: Allowed production methods
production.description: Enable the methods you want to choose in each shot’s method selector. You can combine several.

hints.generated_video: Automatic rendering with the configured video model (H3).
hints.animation_2d: Character and background layers in the 2D editor.
hints.animation_3d: Spatial composition, cameras and models in the 3D editor.
hints.imported_video: Clips made outside Series Lab or with other generators.

production.mixed: Mixed production: the planner can combine the checked methods. You can change the method of each shot.
production.single: New shots use this method. Existing shots keep their selection for review.
production.chooseAllowed: This method is no longer allowed. Choose another to continue.
production.scene2dHint: Opens references as editable layers and keeps dialogue as text. Adjust animation and audio, export the video and import it here as a take.
production.scene3dHint: Opens a composition with images as reference planes. Replace them with 3D models, adjust camera and audio, export and import the take here.
production.importHint: Import a finished clip as a take and review it before approving it for assembly. Its duration must cover the shot.
production.workspaceChanged: Workspace changed. Reopen the shot before continuing.
production.batchHint: These buttons generate AI-assigned shots. Use Automatic 2D production for 2D shots. 3D and imported shots have their own controls.

assets.title: Environments and characters for animation
assets.setupHint: Prepare environment and cast images in the Bible and approve the canon. Each 2D/3D shot needs an environment and references for every visible character.
assets.emptyCast: Establishing shot: uses the environment without visible characters.
assets.completeFirst: Complete the listed environment and characters, approve the canon and update this episode’s references before opening the editor.

states.missingEntity: Unassigned or absent from this episode’s canon
states.missingImage: An approved reference image is missing from this episode
states.availableInSeries: Image available in the series. Review canon and incorporate it into the episode.

production.bulkHint: To change existing shots, choose a method and apply it to shots without a take. Shots with completed or active takes keep their method.
production.bulkMethod: Method for shots without a take
production.bulkApply: Apply to shots without a take ({{count}})

speech.title: Voice and lip sync
speech.missingLink: The linked character is unavailable in this workspace. Unlink it or choose another library character.
speech.reuseHint: Voice and mouth settings belong to the reusable character. Episodes use that link when preparing speech in the editors. AI video with native audio uses its own generator’s voice.
speech.finishEditor: Another configuration is open in Character Creator. Save its changes and return to Series Lab before opening another character.
speech.changedLink: The linked configuration changed. Select the saved character from its Series Lab card.

referenceBatch.title: References for the shots
referenceBatch.missing: {{count}} character or location images used in this episode are missing.
referenceBatch.available: The images already exist in the series. Review their approval and incorporate them into the episode to use them in shots.
referenceBatch.ready: Shot locations and characters have approved references in this episode.
referenceBatch.incorporate: Use approved references in this episode
referenceBatch.hint: Generate missing images, review and approve canon, then incorporate the references. The episode keeps its script and takes.
referenceBatch.generated: Images generated. Review and approve canon before incorporating them into the episode.
referenceBatch.incorporated: Approved references incorporated into the episode. You can now prepare the shots.
referenceBatch.sourceChanged: The project changed. Return to the source episode to continue.

renderActions.hint: AI generation creates video takes awaiting approval. The automatic 2D batch creates and saves its own scenes and takes; you can edit them afterwards.
renderActions.noCandidates: No AI video shots are available for this generation. Check each shot’s production method and takes in Shots.

episodeProgress.title: Episode status and next steps
episodeProgress.referencesMissing: {{count}} episode references need attention. Click a name to open its source.
episodeProgress.referencesReady: Character and location references are approved and incorporated into this episode.
episodeProgress.takes: Video takes: {{missing}} to create · {{review}} awaiting approval · {{approved}} of {{total}} approved.
episodeProgress.missing: Create or import the video take
episodeProgress.review: Take created: review and approval needed
episodeProgress.hint: Approving characters and locations prepares the references; each shot also needs a video take. Generated takes remain unapproved until you review them.

native.title: 2D shots
native.hint: Generate missing shots: remove character backgrounds, use their saved voices and create editable basic animation. Save every scene and video without approving the take. Keep this tab open; you can stop after the current shot.
native.cutoutHint: Keeps the approved original image. The transparent cutout is reused in 2D shots and is also prepared when generating the batch.
native.rendering: Saving and rendering the editable scene…
native.sceneUnavailable: The editable scene for this take is unavailable.
native.lipsyncHint: Reuse the recorded voices and motion with the saved mouth setup. Creates new versions for review and preserves previous and approved takes. Offscreen voices keep their audio. Keep this tab open during the update.
native.updateLipsync: Update lip sync for {{count}} ready shots

lipsyncIssues.link: Link and save this character in Character Creator.
lipsyncIssues.pose: The workshop base is unapproved. Open the character, select “I have reviewed this base image” and save.
lipsyncIssues.mouths: Review and approve each of the four mouth shapes, then save the character.
lipsyncIssues.placement: Place the mouth on the base pose and save the workshop.

native.blockedUpdates: {{shots}} shots need setup reviewed for {{characters}} characters. Open their settings using these links; other ready shots can still be updated.
native.noUpdates: No takes need updating. Approved takes are preserved.
native.initialSpeechSetup: Before generating dialogue shots, complete these characters:
